quest.title: Blocked?
quest.description: Jack was on his way to a new adventure spot, but has found himself under attack by hilichurls at Drunkard Gorge. Defeat the hilichurls and save Jack.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Traveler, it's you! Thank you so much.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Can I ask you for a favor...?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: This roadblock here is the only thing getting between me and my adventure...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Can you get rid of it for me?

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: *sigh* I wish I was more like you... I'd be a veteran Adventurer by now!

choices.text: I'd love to, but I have to get going.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Please, I'm begging you... I can't let this be where my adventure ends!

talks.objective: Defeat all opponents and destroy the roadblocks

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: I was on my way to check out somewhere Stanley once went on an adventure. Had I known they would show up...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: I'm just not strong enough... I know for a fact that Stanley would have had no problem dealing with a group like that.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Why don't you join me? Join me! ...Ugh, never mind, I can't have someone else doing even my adventuring for me...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: I'm going to get moving. This is for you, I've gathered loads on the way to supplement my rations.
